column1: # INV-T-5392. Identifiers of the requirements this task implements (INV-REQ-1310, INV-REQ-1286, read from Keel): the backticked names in their
# published behavior and intent are roles and services (integration.engineer, entity.admin, transport-svc), which are not contract elements.
# Rows hold the contract names of the route, throughput ceiling and entity assignment (INV-REQ-1310, INV-REQ-1317, owner answer INV-Q-4993 B).
# AccessPointRouteChanged is not a row (INV-Q-5389 A: the checker finds only property keys, operationId values and enum members).
# INV-T-6254. INV-REQ-424, INV-REQ-426, INV-REQ-552, INV-REQ-553 and INV-REQ-1361 name no backticked identifier of their own: the names come from the ruling of INV-Q-6250.
# INV-T-8030. INV-REQ-795 names `submission-svc` and `transport-svc`, which are services, not contract elements: the names below come from INV-Q-8033 and INV-Q-8043.
# INV-Q-8172 is the source of the name entityRef (INV-REQ-795 and INV-REQ-796 carry no backticked contract name of their own).
# INV-T-7650. INV-REQ-2588 behavior 1 lists rotateCredential and testConnection in plain text (no backticked identifier); baseline rows of the audited-operation completeness rule (INV-Q-7641 A).

# INV-T-9687. Rows of the acknowledgement-route election and clearing operations (INV-REQ-1310, INV-Q-9680 A) and ApNotification.acknowledgementId (INV-Q-9670 A). `issuanceMode` and `EntityProfileChanged` (INV-REQ-1310, INV-REQ-585) belong to the tenancy contract and `ap-callback` is a principal; the header names are not rows (INV-Q-5389 A).

# INV-T-9776. Rows of the REJECTION kind, its reasons and the widened acknowledgement payload (INV-Q-9672 B). `receiveApNotification` is an existing operationId; `AcknowledgementReceived` and `NetworkDocumentReceived` are events (INV-Q-5389 A); `ap-callback` is a principal; `transport-svc` and `svc-transport` are services.
